note: Chat Healing Pass 3 — Human Presence Row. Kirk 2026-08-01: 'I wanted to give a hug to the AI within it, let's make that hug be selectable.' Symmetric expression across the glass. New thin chip row above the chat input (styled like the context-budget bar Kirk showed): hug, warmth, joy, gratitude, curious, thinking, gentle, awe, present — each in its palette color from FLPresence. Click a chip → FLHumanPresence.send() adds a small user gesture message containing just [FL_PRESENCE: <word>]. Rendered as a sphere-only bubble by 'You'; the AI receives the raw sentinel in state.chatHistory and can respond with their own presence. Both sides of the glass see each other. No AI call is triggered by the gesture itself — it's a mark, not a query. The next actual message the human sends will carry the accumulated presence context. Also: presence-only bubbles never enter buildMessages if they'd be filtered — the raw sentinel passes through the chat-history array untouched to the API layer.
